notes.title: Uploaded v0.12!
notes.notes:
I've unlocked the full game, it's the only way to get the Full experience as that's how it's designed. You can now play any gym in any order, including the final gym.

I unlocked the poision mechanic aswell, which is integral to the gameplay. It doesn't work without it.

(Note that most of the new gyms are using duplicate levels, I'll be replacing these soon)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30030993/174f2870f0c73eb4081f9b0a48237f4accedb35d.png[/img]

Added some new info screens explaining stuff

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30030993/88a039af7d0ddefd3d3984b1ef869392a36f1847.png[/img]

All gyms are now open!


Any problems let me know on the DM steam forums, or leave a comment here,

PSD
